identityReview: Moroccan financier Othman Benjelloun, not Brahim Benjelloun-Touimi or writer Tahar Ben Jelloun. Distinguish Moroccan BANK OF AFRICA parent, previously BMCE, from the BOA network founded in Mali in 1982.
lifeStatusEvidence: Le Desk / MAP report of 13 April 2026 explicitly names Othman Benjelloun among those welcoming the Crown Prince at the Mohammed VI Tower inauguration. Current bank and holding-company rosters corroborate office.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read targeted 2023 report biography/table, current bank and holding biographies, both bank histories, foundation background/chronology, relevant Le Desk/MAP paragraphs and Commons metadata.
corrections: Read targeted biography/table only. No birth day or graduation year. The 2019–2025 term and family description are historical, not current personal status.
Do not confuse with Brahim Benjelloun-Touimi or attribute other directors biographies to him. Honorary fellowships are not earned degrees.
Corporate promotional judgments not treated as independent assessment. No specific engineering discipline, degree title or graduation year established.
Privatization is not foundation. Rename in 2015 differs from 2020; corporate assets and stakes are not personal holdings.
No claim Benjelloun founded this network in 1982. Historical 2021 stake is not a current stake. 2011 executive handover differs from 2010 majority control.
Institutional account is not an independent measurement of educational outcomes; do not imply he taught or personally built schools.
Launch and school opening are separate. English index.php page returned verification wall; French page read successfully.
Press report establishes attendance; do not call him architect or assume every component commercially opened that day. Only relevant inauguration and reception paragraphs used.
